goal: Add CONTROL_COMMAND_APPROVE and CONTROL_COMMAND_REJECT verbs (reject with an optional {feedback: str} payload) plus flywheel approve RUN_ID and flywheel reject RUN_ID [--feedback TEXT] CLI producers that enqueue one control_commands row and treat AWAITING_APPROVAL as the valid in-flight status.

references: src/flywheel/invoker_client.py:57-61 -- recognized control-verb constants; add approve/reject here
src/flywheel/invoker_client.py:88-109 -- _payload_text / _payload_model validator templates; reject's feedback validator mirrors these
constraints: reject validates an optional {"feedback": str} payload: absent is allowed; a non-string feedback is a payload validation error mirroring _payload_model.
The live in-session watcher records approve/reject as not-applied (no live session in AWAITING_APPROVAL) rather than dispatching them to a session or crashing.

The producers build on _enqueue_control_command (workflow.py:1938); the not-in-flight check at workflow.py:1965 (in_flight = lifecycle.status in (Status.RUNNING, Status.VALIDATING)) must treat AWAITING_APPROVAL as a valid in-flight status for these two verbs so the producer does not warn when enqueuing against a correctly-parked run.

Add tests: tests/test_invoker_client.py for the new verb constants and reject-payload validation; tests/test_workflow.py for (a) flywheel approve enqueues a kind=approve row, (b) flywheel reject --feedback X enqueues kind=reject with the feedback payload, (c) enqueuing against a non-AWAITING_APPROVAL run prints the pending/stale note, (d) an unknown run_id exits 2.
Call mcp__ide__getDiagnostics on every touched .py file and fix all type errors before verify.
Commit with a Conventional Commits message before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: No resolver application (resolve-manual-approval consumes these rows).
